Before you start.

Answers about accounts, offline use and Multidex Plus.

Is Multidex an official Pokémon app?

No. Multidex is a fan-made app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company. Its data comes from PokéAPI.

Do I need an account?

No. Everything free works without signing in. Sign in with Google when you want Multidex Plus to stay with your account.

Does it work offline?

Yes, for entries you've already opened. Multidex saves them on your device and refreshes them in the background when you're online.

Is Multidex suitable for younger fans?

Multidex has no ads and doesn't use the advertising ID. Sign-in and Plus are optional, and younger fans should use them with a parent or guardian. Read the privacy policy.

How do I cancel Multidex Plus?

Cancel it in Google Play's subscriptions. Plus stays active until the end of the period you've paid for. Subscription information.

How do I delete my account?

Choose Delete account in the account menu or Settings, or email us if you no longer have the app. Account and data deletion.
